This is `AGGREGATE-VIEW-FIELD`, and it is refused by name rather than left to the generic field-type message

a `source.record.v1` record type is outside the copy-scalar task execution profile: the transferability judgment has no aggregate kind and the scoped-task ledger is keyed by plain name, so a record — owning or not — can neither be captured by a spawn nor held across a join (`AGGREGATE-TASK-CAPTURE`)
